calendar.session_rule: a date is an eligible market session when the supplier's is_non_session(date) is False (weekends and full-day closures excluded); never weekday arithmetic

A_material_challenger_in_true_forward_co.cross_domain: positive incremental portfolio utility after costs for incumbent + sleeve against incumbent-only under equal capital / risk, same evidence discipline; AND registered prospectively through the human-gated adoption path
A_material_challenger_in_true_forward_co.same_domain: passes the repository's frozen historical materiality gates against the incumbent on the identical sample: net advantage >= 0.015/yr, lockbox sign agreement, halves floor, turnover cap, drawdown multiple, Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 over the executed denominator, family-aware Holm; AND is registered prospectively through the human-gated adoption path

frozen_success_criteria.B_owned_free_information_exhausted: every ranked owned / free information family closed under its budget with a named binding failure, plus the exact missing information with acquisition path, cost, break-even alpha, confidence haircut and expected portfolio value

incumbent.role: BENCHMARK, not the presumed correct model

start_session_counts_as: session 0 (the campaign's own session); the ten sessions STRICTLY AFTER it are the stop-loss window
